body.method: Each boundary is found by holding this entity's other features fixed and binary-searching the probed feature against the live scorer until the prediction crosses the flag threshold.

counterfactuals.observed: No single factor accounts for this score on its own — 5 signals reinforce each other
counterfactuals.boundary: Taken together: if the debit had followed the call by more than 22 minutes, onward movement were under 95%, funds reached fewer than 1.0 accounts, the amount were under Rs 76,800, and counterparty stability were above 0.60, this entity would not have been flagged.

counterfactuals.observed: Rs 3,200 was debited 22 minutes after an inbound call from +917455623869 ("Fuel")
counterfactuals.boundary: Widening the gap between the call and the debit alone would not have cleared this entity — other signals keep it flagged.

counterfactuals.observed: 95% of an inbound Rs 76,800 credit was moved onward across 1 account(s) within 30 minutes
counterfactuals.boundary: Reducing the onward share alone would not have cleared this entity.

counterfactuals.observed: Funds reached 1 account(s) in a single hop-out
counterfactuals.boundary: Narrowing the fan-out alone would not have cleared this entity.

counterfactuals.observed: Rs 76,800 passed through accounts under this entity's control
counterfactuals.boundary: A smaller amount alone would not have cleared this entity.

counterfactuals.observed: Funds moved to largely fresh counterparties (stability 0.60)
counterfactuals.boundary: Steadier counterparties alone would not have cleared this entity.
